title: A Letter to the Bank
text:
Dear Mr. Lopez, I am writing about my bank account. Last week, I received a letter with a wrong address. I would like you to correct it as soon as possible. Thank you for your help.

I have attached a copy of my identity card. Please send a new letter to my home address. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Yours sincerely, Ana Ruiz.

questions.text: What was wrong with the letter the writer received?
options: The letter was written in Spanish

questions.text: What did the writer attach to the letter?
options: A copy of her identity card

questions.text: What is the writer's tone in the letter?
Why does the writer say 'I look forward to hearing from you soon'?
options: She wants to close her account

vocabulary.definition: the place where a person lives or where a letter is sent
sent together with a letter or email
to change something so that it is right

paragraph_translations: Estimado Sr. Lopez, le escribo sobre mi cuenta bancaria. La semana pasada recibi una carta con una direccion incorrecta. Me gustaria que la corrigiera lo antes posible. Gracias por su ayuda.
Le he adjuntado una copia de mi documento de identidad. Por favor, envie una nueva carta a mi direccion de casa. Espero su respuesta pronto. Atentamente, Ana Ruiz.
